title: Fix AppTheme animation getter analyzer errors
description: Flutter analyze reports undefined AppTheme animation getters (animFast, animPulse, animSlow, animNormal) after theme/color centralization. Fix the root cause without broad refactors and verify flutter analyze no longer reports these undefined_getter errors.
notes: Investigation: root cause is broader than AppTheme.anim*. flutter analyze reports 2,114 unique error lines, many caused by corrupted null-coalescing operators: code that should be ?? appears as single ? (examples: uth.value?.isAuthenticated ? false, overflowList?.cast<...>() ? [], double.tryParse(current) ? 0). This appears to be a repository-wide mechanical corruption, not a single theme getter bug. Do not mass-edit without explicit approval; safest next step is a controlled codemod or selective restore after reviewing diff.
